notes.title: New Trailer Out & BitSummit 13th Exhibition Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, I’m [b]@gunzee2[/b], the developer of [b]Algolemeth[/b].
We’re thrilled to announce that Algolemeth will be playable at [b]“BitSummit the 13th”[/b] in Kyoto next week![/p][hr][/hr][h3]▸ Event Overview[/h3][p][b]Dates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Business Day[/b]: [b]Friday, July 18, 2025[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Public Days[/b]: [b]Saturday–Sunday, July 19–20, 2025[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Location[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Kyoto International Exhibition Hall (Miyako Messe)[/b] – 3rd Floor, [b]GYAAR Studio Booth[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The GYAAR Studio area will feature our fellow contest title [b]“Summer Road”[/b] in a festive [i]summer-festival[/i] layout—complete with a raffle where you can win prizes![/p][p]Algolemeth will be there with its [b]latest playable build[/b], ready for you to dive in.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]▸ Highlights of the New Build[/h3][list][*][p][b]Multiple unreleased tracks by legendary composer Yuzo Koshiro[/b][/p][list][*][p]One of them is a [i]high-octane boss-battle BGM[/i]![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Get hands-on, crank up the volume, and experience the [b]all-powerful feeling[/b] of directing Algolemeth’s nodes yourself.[/p][/*][/list][p]I, [b]@gunzee2[/b], will be around the booth as much as possible—please come say hi and share your feedback![/p][hr][/hr][h3]▸ New Promo Video[/h3][p]To celebrate BitSummit, we’ve dropped a brand-new trailer that digs deeper into the game itself.
Our new tagline is [b]“Connect the Nodes, Hack the Dungeon!”[/b][/p][p]The video showcases Algolemeth’s visual-programming mechanics and that same sense of omnipotence—and, of course, features another completely original track composed by Yuzo Koshiro just for our game. Don’t miss it![/p][hr][/hr][h3]See You in Kyoto![/h3][p]We look forward to meeting you at the [b]GYAAR Studio Booth, 3F Miyako Messe, July 18–20[/b].
If you like what you see, adding Algolemeth to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b] would mean the world to us.[/p][p]See you in Kyoto![/p]

notes.title: Big Announcement! Legendary Composer Yuzo Koshiro to Compose Algolemeth's BGM!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 Big Announcement! 🎉[/h1]

[previewyoutube=jSc-CnW27F4;full][/previewyoutube]

The BGM for the fully-automated dungeon RPG Algolemeth will be composed by none other than the legendary Yuzo Koshiro, known for his work on many classic titles!

All tracks in this game are created using Sega Genesis-style FM synthesis.
This hot, retro-inspired sound will energize both your dungeon exploration and strategic battles!

As someone who has admired Koshiro since childhood, I’m overjoyed that he kindly agreed to this dream collaboration.

Despite being an indie developer, he warmly accepted my request, and I am deeply grateful. I also want to sincerely thank everyone who helped make this dream come true.

🎮 You can get an early experience of Koshiro's music at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 on May 4th!
Please stop by booth 2F-8!

I will continue moving forward, aiming to create a game that not only meets your expectations, but excites me more than anyone.

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: ウィッシュリスト登録者数が10,000人を突破しました！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/62d4f901d7afc07e6d409fc4b97b4338699c32a7.png[/img]
Hello!

Recently, we released the new main visual for Algolemeth, and right after that, the number of wishlist registrations on Steam surpassed 10,000! Thank you so much!!

I've been providing updates on our progress through [url=https://x.com/Algolemeth/status/1860565396899922064]X[/url] and our [url=https://medium-rare.jpn.org/archives/2064]blog[/url], but now, we’ve finally crossed the 10,000 mark. To be honest, I had been quite conscious of this milestone ever since we reached around 8,000, so I feel a sense of relief now that we've achieved it.

However, the wishlist count is not just a number; I see it as a reflection of everyone’s expectations for Algolemeth. The more it grows, the greater the responsibility to ensure that the game turns out to be truly enjoyable. This realization makes me want to approach development with even greater dedication.

To be honest, I’m not yet confident that I can create something that will satisfy every single person who is looking forward to the game. However, at the very least, I want to create something that I personally believe is good, and then ask all of you—“What do you think?” My hope is that it will resonate with as many people as possible.

As I mentioned in my previous update, this Saturday, February 15th, we will be exhibiting at [url=https://tokyogamedungeon.com]Tokyo Game Dungeon 7[/url].

Over the past few weeks, we’ve been preparing for the event, and I feel that this demo build is the most enjoyable one yet. If you're in Tokyo this weekend, come visit us in Hamamatsuchō and share your thoughts on the game!

notes.title: New Main Visual Revealed! & Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Main Visual Revealed![/h1]

Hello! I'm Gunzee ([url=https://x.com/gunzee2]@gunzee2[/url]), the developer of Algolemeth!  

Today, we’re excited to unveil the brand-new main visual for Algolemeth!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/48a6495bbae9cbcbfe860f626776a837dc194515.png[/img]  

This stunning artwork was created by [url=https://x.com/sanaki385]@sanaki385[/url]!  

I've wanted to update the main visual and character portraits for a long time, and now that dream has finally come true! This was made possible thanks to GYAARCon’s development support, which connected me with an amazing artist. Huge thanks to everyone involved!  

[h1]New PV Released![/h1]  

Alongside the new visual, we’ve also updated the PV! While the structure remains the same, most of the footage has been replaced with the latest in-game visuals. Be sure to check out the new title logo reveal!  

[previewyoutube=km0wWATFf_4;full][/previewyoutube]  

We’ve also updated all the images on the store page, so if you’d like to take a closer look, be sure to check it out.  

And while you're there, don’t forget to [b]add Algolemeth to your wishlist!  [/b]

[h1]Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 on 2/15/2025![/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/13e68e0806c65a8945452d348af9166eb22352e1.png[/img]  

On Saturday, February 15, Algolemeth will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 in Hamamatsucho, Tokyo! Our booth number is [b]D-6!  [/b]

We'll be bringing the latest playable build, featuring the new visuals and tons of improvements from a year ago! The game has evolved significantly, merging exploration and combat - so come try it out and share your thoughts!  
(Warning: it might be a bit more complex than before...)  

This marks my first solo exhibition in about a year, so I apologize in advance for any rough spots! Looking forward to seeing you all next week!  

[h1]A Big Announcement Coming Soon…!?[/h1]  

And lastly, a little teaser - within the next few months, we might have an exciting announcement to share!  

Just to clarify, this won't be the release date reveal just yet. But when the time comes, I believe many of you will be thrilled to hear it! Stay tuned for upcoming updates!  

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: The release of Algolemeth has been postponed to 2025.
notes.notes:
We regret to inform you that the release of 'Algolemeth' has been postponed from 2024 to 2025. Originally, we set a tight release date to push ourselves, but after winning the GYAARStudio Indie Game Contest, we received additional development funding and support, which has expanded the possibilities for the game. As a result, we now have the opportunity to make it even better, which requires more time.

Although a year and a half has passed since the first exhibition, we understand that this delay may disappoint those of you who have been eagerly awaiting the release. I sincerely apologize for this. It is entirely due to my misjudgment.

We are working hard to enhance not only the game system but also the graphics and music. We aim to deliver a more polished version in 2025, and we will announce the official release date as soon as it is decided. Thank you for your continued support!

Announcement!

We are excited to announce that Algolemeth will be showcased at Tokyo Game Show 2024!

Just like at our previous appearance at gamescom, we will be exhibiting thanks to winning the “2nd GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest.” We are truly grateful for this opportunity!

At this exhibition, you’ll be able to play the latest build of Algolemeth! The developers will also be attending the event on September 28th and 29th. Please drop by the booth and share your thoughts with us directly!

notes.title: We showcased Algolemeth at gamescom 2024!
notes.notes:
[b]In August 2024, we showcased Algolemeth at the gamescom 2024 in Cologne![/b]

This time, thanks to our connection with the GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest, we had the opportunity to exhibit within the GYAAR Studio supported by Supercell booth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794881/8ac75692aacecee003d606f4b854a40f2d79bd2f.jpg[/img]
The event was a great success, and many people had the chance to try out the game. Thank you to everyone who visited us!

Through this exhibition, we felt confident that Algolemeth can be enjoyed by players worldwide. As we move forward, we aim to reach not only Japanese players but also gamers around the globe. Whether you’ve already experienced Algolemeth or are eagerly anticipating its release, we would be thrilled if you could support us by spreading the word about Algolemeth on social media!

We will continue to exhibit at future events, so please stay tuned for updates on Steam News and our posts on X!
